400 Bad Request error when OCR input has an invalid image format

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

do {
    let _req = try LiterLlm.ocrRequestFromJson("{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"invalid://url\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}")
    guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
    let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
    _ = try await _client.ocr(_req)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
